integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible finite consistency checks provided; numerical experiments are not used as an infinite proof. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Two complete Euclidean circles and univariate complex polynomials only; no assertion of globally minimal sample count or noise-stable reconstruction. Prior qualitative circle dichotomy already established by Chalendar–Partington; historical priority for the stronger degree classification remains subject to independent examination.
title: Degree quantization and complete phase-ambiguity normal form on intersecting circles
